intro.text: A towering skyscraper raised by House Tekiel in the financial district of Elendel's Fourth Octant, facing the Ironspine Building over the 4th-5th Canal.

description.text: Even unfinished, it rose high enough for its top to disappear into the mists whenever they rolled in, which was seldom.

Its construction became a race with the Ironspine Building for the title of Elendel's tallest, each side's architects redrawing their plans ever higher; reliable rumor put both at over fifty stories. It still stood unfinished during the Vanishers' raids, its completion in doubt after House Tekiel's finances collapsed.
